title: Rental, Towing, Trip Interruption and Roadside Benefits — Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contracts
content:
Benefits beyond the repair itself differ by Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contracts coverage level. All amounts are in USD.

| Coverage level | Rental per day | Most rental days per claim | Towing per breakdown, up to | Trip interruption per day | Most trip-interruption days | Least distance from home for trip interruption (miles) | 24-hour roadside assistance |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kessler Shield Powertrain | 0.00 | 0 | 100.00 | 0.00 | 0 | 100 | not included |
| Kessler Shield Powertrain Plus | 35.00 | 3 | 100.00 | 0.00 | 0 | 100 | included |
| Kessler Shield Select | 40.00 | 5 | 100.00 | 100.00 | 3 | 100 | included |
| Kessler Shield Preferred | 45.00 | 5 | 125.00 | 100.00 | 3 | 100 | included |
| Kessler Shield Exclusionary | 50.00 | 7 | 150.00 | 150.00 | 5 | 100 | included |
| Kessler Shield Exclusionary Wrap | 60.00 | 7 | 150.00 | 150.00 | 5 | 100 | included |

**Zero figures.** A per-day amount or day limit of 0 means the level has no such benefit. Kessler Shield Powertrain therefore has neither a rental nor a trip-interruption benefit, and Kessler Shield Powertrain Plus has no trip-interruption benefit.

**Roadside assistance.** Where included, it covers jump starts, lockouts, fuel delivery and flat-tire changes, arranged through the 24-hour roadside line.

**Distance column.** The distance is measured from the holder's home ZIP to the place of the breakdown. A breakdown at least that far away qualifies; a nearer one does not.
